prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1275; do not mention it.)
text:
I represent the injured party in connection with the sideswipe collision that occurred while our client was changing lanes. Please direct all further communications regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or electronic means.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of the policy you issued to the at-fault driver, along with a declaration of any other coverage that may apply to this loss. Please provide this information in writing within the time frame required by applicable law.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes claim files, recorded statements, photographs, vehicle data and telematics, repair estimates, adjuster notes, and any dash camera or roadway footage in your possession or control. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of such materials until this matter is fully resolved.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this request.
